briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Escalating Doses of BMS-986463 in Participants With Select Advanced Malignant Tumors.

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status of 0 or 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status of 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have at least 1 lesion accessible for biopsy in addition to the target lesion, from which a fresh pre treatment biopsy must be obtained.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or requirement to undergo a biopsy procedure is subjective/judgment-based and not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have an unresectable/metastatic carcinoma.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unresectable/metastatic carcinoma does not list a specific numbered stage list for a stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have Leptomeningeal metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal metastases is a specific type of CNS involvement that does not cleanly fit the standard allowedBrainMets categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have at least 1 lesion accessible for biopsy in addition to the target lesion, from which a fresh pre treatment biopsy must be obtained.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or accessibility for biopsy is a subjective clinical procedure judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have an unresectable/metastatic carcinoma.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unresectable or metastatic carcinoma is descriptive rather than a numbered stage list, and NSCLC is one of multiple solid tumor types included.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have Leptomeningeal metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal metastases are not a general brain_mets exclusion type for parenchymal CNS disease.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have concurrent malignancy (present during screening) requiring treatment or history of prior malignancy active within 2 years prior to treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent malignancy with a time-based history rule is not a typed prior therapy or biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have had any prior radiation therapy within 2 weeks prior to start of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiation washouts are not captured by the allowed prior_therapy_excluded kinds.
